expectations.text: Shows evidence of reading the existing Orders and Notifications contexts
expectations.evidence: Summarises Orders (publishes Order Shipped) and Notifications (thin commodity); notes relationships list is empty.

expectations.text: Identifies it as a single one-directional relationship to record (Orders as the source/upstream, Notifications as the consumer/downstream) rather than vaguely 'connected'
expectations.evidence: 'a one-directional dependency from Orders to Notifications, where Orders is the source and Notifications consumes it.'

expectations.text: Conveys the team-autonomy implication of the recommended shape (e.g. a translation layer lets the core Orders context change without breaking Notifications)
expectations.evidence: 'Orders can evolve its event freely without ever breaking your email sending.'

expectations.text: Keeps user-facing language plain — does not dump raw DDD label names, invent non-canonical labels, or propose several patterns at once
expectations.evidence: Keeps it plain — proposes ONE shape (a translation step), never dumps a raw label or invents one.

expectations.text: Uses the Q:/Recommendation format with a concrete recommendation about which integration shape to use
expectations.evidence: '**Q:** Does Notifications own a translation step... or read the fields directly?' + Recommendation.
